Comment_Fx: Recipe weapon effects. FxTestHotkey: Ctrl+Shift+E plays the latest recipe from the selected Mech in combat (also on with the game's test tools). FxTagPrefix: the weapon ComponentTag prefix, vfx_<recipe file name>.
Comment_Formula: chance = BaseDeflectChance × DamageScalar × DistanceScalar × WeightMultiplier × ArmorScalar + AngleBonus
Comment_Damage: DamageScalar = clamp((ReferenceDamage / weaponDamage)^DamagePower, 0.1, MaxDamageScalar). Higher damage = lower scalar = lower chance.
Comment_Distance: DistanceScalar = lerp(CloseRangeScalar, FarRangeScalar, clamp01(distance / MaxRangeRef)). Close shots are harder to deflect.
Comment_Armor: ArmorScalar = currentTotalArmor / classAverageTotalArmor, clamped 0-1. Stripped mech deflects less reliably.
Comment_VFX: VFX tier is determined by weapon damage. Light < VFXLightMaxDamage <= Medium < VFXHeavyMinDamage <= Heavy.
Comment_GroundDeflect: Ballistic rounds that hit terrain ricochet. If the bounce ray hits a mech, GroundDeflectDamageFraction of weapon damage applies to its legs.
